verdict.rationale: monday.com exposes a full API, webhooks, and programmatic agent management ("Run and manage every monday agent programmatically from your own code, anywhere you need it") which supports headless automation calls, e.g. from a CI script updating boards or triggering agents. However, the docs also state agent execution happens in monday-managed sandboxes on monday's own infra rather than the user's runtime, and there's no explicit CI/CD integration guide, CLI tool, or llms.txt (404 probe) confirming a documented headless workflow. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples or CLI/headless runner docs, confirmation that automation logic can execute in the user's own CI environment rather than only monday's hosted sandbox, and independent hands-on verification of headless usage.
